% Shared by every language version: page setup and the entry layout. The
% generated file (scripts/build-cv.mjs) loads babel before this one and sets
% the header after it.
\usepackage[a4paper, left=0.6in, top=0.55in, right=0.6in, bottom=0.5in]{geometry}

% One entry in Experience, Projects or Education: bold title and dates on one
% line, then a plain description.
\newcommand{\entry}[3]{%
  {\bf #1}\hfill #2\\
  #3\par\vspace{1ex}%
}
